# One Calculator

One Calculator is a free library of single-purpose online calculators — 176 tools, one clean calculator for each job: payments, percentages, health numbers, dates and project materials. One Calculator has nothing to do with numerology; results are estimates.

Made for people who want one answer without the clutter — and for businesses, workers and students who value speed.

All 176 calculators are free, with no account or sign-up. Every calculator shows its formula or method and at least one worked example.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://onecalculator.site/): all 176 calculators, organized by category.
- [Embed these calculators](https://onecalculator.site/embed.html): put any of the 176 One Calculator calculators on your own site for free — no account, no attribution required.
- [Partnerships](https://onecalculator.site/partnerships.html): the network One Calculator belongs to, and how to partner with us.
- [Creator ROI Hub — Earnings, Sponsorship & Fee Calculators](https://onecalculator.site/creator-roi-calculators.html): The Creator ROI Hub: free calculators for people who publish for a living — YouTube and TikTok earnings, sponsorship rates, payment fees and AI API costs, with honest ranges and the math shown.
